name: Tech Partners Hawaii
old_description: Over 20 years and hundreds of clients across the Hawaiian Islands. We keep your business running so you don't have to think about IT.
about:
Tech Partners Hawaii has provided IT support from its Wailuku, Maui base for over two decades. The locally owned company was founded to serve businesses across the Hawaiian Islands and now works with hundreds of clients throughout the chain.

The firm delivers a full stack of managed technology services: managed IT, IT consulting, VoIP, Microsoft 365 administration, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, backup and disaster recovery, and network management. Its team holds multiple certifications and operates a 24/7 help desk to keep client systems running continuously.

Customers span Hawaii's key sectors, including hospitality and tourism, non-profits, development and construction, manufacturing, medical practices, and agriculture. The company tailors its support to the operational rhythms of each industry, from resort networks to clinic compliance requirements.

Tech Partners Hawaii differentiates itself through six stated pillars: local ownership with island-specific knowledge, certified expertise, responsive 24/7 support, a multilayered security framework, seamless migration from in-house or other providers, and a customer-service culture aligned with Hawaii's community values.
